transcribed_question:
IDENTIFY THE PROBES SPACE
B) THE LINE PINK RELATES TO WHAT?

marker.description: Blue paint mark on the skull base

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the blue paint.
main_explanation: The blue paint marks the foramen ovale, a large opening in the greater wing of the sphenoid bone that transmits the mandibular nerve (V3), accessory meningeal artery, and lesser petrosal nerve.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures passes through the foramen indicated by the blue paint?
supporting_question.explanation: The foramen ovale transmits the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve (V3). The facial nerve exits via the stylomastoid foramen, the abducens nerve via the superior orbital fissure, and the hypoglossal nerve via the hypoglossal canal.
